title: 空调不制冷，约中介派的空调师傅上门
titleEn: Booking the aircon tech when your split system blows warm air
scene: 周日早上，下周天气预报连续几天 35 度以上，可你家客厅的分体空调（split system）开了半小时还在吹热风，室外机好像也不怎么转。你周五在 tenant portal 上报了修，物业经理批了 work order，把单子转给了常合作的空调师傅 Brett。今天上午 Brett 打电话过来，人很热情，但说话快，满嘴行话和口语：regas、kick in、have a squiz、bit of a backlog……
你的目标：① 把故障说清楚（吹热风、室外机不启动、遥控器模式已检查过）；② 听懂他让你先自查的几件事（模式、滤网、电闸），以及上门时间、费用由谁出；③ 约好上门时间段和进门方式，并请他短信确认。

facts.v: Brett：中介合作的空调师傅（aircon tech）
周二下午 12 点到 3 点之间上门，到前 20 分钟打电话
14 Wattle Street, Prospect（客厅分体空调，室外机在侧院）
走中介 work order，房东付；若只是滤网脏，call-out fee 可能要租客出

vocab.zh: 分体式空调（澳洲最常见）
vocab.ex: The split system in the lounge is only blowing warm air.
The outdoor unit doesn't seem to kick in at all.
It hums for a bit, but the cold air never kicks in.
The remote's been playing up for a few weeks.
If it's low on gas, I'll need to regas it.
Can you have a squiz at the filters for me?
If the filters are clogged up, it can't cool properly.
With this heat, we've got a bit of a backlog.
I can give you a window between twelve and three.
If it's just dirty filters, you might cop the call-out fee.
If it needs a new part, I'll quote it up and send it to the agent.

listening.en: G'day, it's Brett from Cool Breeze Air — got a job sheet here from your agent. Is now a good time?
listening.sound: G'day 读作 “g'die”；job sheet = 派工单，说得很快像 “jobsheet”
listening.zh: 你好，我是 Cool Breeze 空调的 Brett，你们中介给我派了单。现在方便说话吗？
listening.reply: Yes, now's fine. Thanks for calling back so quickly.

listening.en: Righto, so what's it doin' — is it just not cooling, or is it not coming on at all?
listening.sound: Righto = 好的；what's it doin' 的 g 吞掉，连成 “wotsit-doin”
listening.zh: 好嘞，那它是什么情况——只是不制冷，还是根本开不了？
listening.reply: It comes on, but it only blows warm air, even on eighteen degrees.

listening.en: Can you duck outside and have a squiz — is the fan on the outdoor unit spinnin'?
listening.sound: duck outside = 快速出去一下；have a squiz = 看一眼；spinnin' 吞 g
listening.zh: 你能出去看一眼吗——室外机的风扇在转吗？
listening.reply: Hang on, I'll check. ... No, it's not moving at all.

listening.en: Sounds like it could be the capacitor, could be low on gas — won't know till I get the gauges on it.
listening.sound: capacitor（电容）是难词，不认识就记住“一个零件”；gauges = 压力表，读 “gay-jiz”
listening.zh: 听起来可能是电容坏了，也可能是缺冷媒——要接上压力表才知道。
listening.reply: Okay. Is that something you can fix on the day?

listening.en: With this heat comin' we've got a bit of a backlog, so earliest I can do is Tuesdee arvo.
listening.sound: Tuesdee = Tuesday；arvo = afternoon；backlog = 积压的单
listening.zh: 天要热了，我们活儿积了不少，最早只能周二下午。
listening.reply: Tuesday afternoon works. What time roughly?

listening.en: No dramas, I'll flick you a text the day before and give you a buzz when I'm twenty out.
listening.sound: No dramas = 没问题；flick you a text = 给你发个短信；twenty out = 还有二十分钟到
listening.zh: 没问题，我前一天给你发短信，到之前二十分钟给你打电话。
listening.reply: Perfect, thanks Brett. I'll keep my phone on me.

speech.topic: 我在澳洲第一次遇到家里电器坏了
paragraphs: The first time something broke in our rental, I didn't know what to do. It was the middle of summer, and the aircon in the living room suddenly started blowing warm air. It was thirty-eight degrees outside, and the kids were hot and grumpy. My first thought was to call someone and pay for it myself, but a friend told me to contact the property manager first.

So I logged into the tenant portal and reported the problem. I wrote down what was happening, added a photo of the outdoor unit, and said it was quite urgent because of the heat. The agent replied the next day. She said she had sent a work order to an aircon technician, and he would call me to book a time.

The phone call was harder than I expected. The technician spoke really fast and used words I didn't know, like regas and capacitor. I asked him to slow down a couple of times, and he was happy to explain. He also asked me to check the filters and the mode on the remote, which I hadn't thought of.

In the end, he came on a Tuesday afternoon and fixed it in about an hour. The landlord paid for it, so it didn't cost us anything. I learned three things: report problems in writing, describe them clearly, and don't be afraid to ask people to repeat themselves. Now I feel much more confident when something goes wrong at home.
speech.zh: 第一次租的房子里电器坏了，我不知道该怎么办。那是盛夏，客厅空调突然吹热风，外面 38 度，孩子们又热又烦。我本想自己找人修、自己付钱，朋友提醒我先联系物业经理。于是我在租客平台上报修，写清情况、附上室外机照片，并说明因为天热比较紧急。中介第二天回复说已经把派工单发给空调师傅，他会打电话约时间。电话比想象中难，师傅说得很快，还用了 regas、capacitor 这些我不认识的词。我请他说慢一点，他也很乐意解释，还让我先检查滤网和遥控器模式。最后他周二下午上门，一个小时就修好了，房东出钱。我学到三点：书面报修、描述清楚、不怕请别人重复。现在家里出问题时我自信多了。

patterns.en: It comes on, but it only ___.
I've already checked ___, and it's still ___.
patterns.zh: 我已经检查过……，还是……（说明已自查）

patterns.en: Is that something you can ___ on the day?
Who'd be paying for ___ — me or the landlord?

lines.en: G'day, it's Brett from Cool Breeze Air. I've got a job sheet here from your agent, for the split system at Wattle Street. Is now an okay time?
lines.zh: 你好，我是 Cool Breeze 空调的 Brett。中介给我派了单，说是 Wattle 街那台分体空调。现在方便吗？

lines.en: Hi Brett, yes, now's fine. Thanks for calling on a Sunday.
lines.zh: 嗨 Brett，方便的。谢谢你周日还打过来。

lines.en: No worries, it's that time of year — everyone's aircon decides to pack it in the week before a heatwave. So what's it doin'? Not cooling, or not coming on at all?
lines.zh: 没事，每年这时候都这样——热浪来之前一周，大家的空调都会罢工。那它是什么情况？不制冷，还是开不了？

lines.en: It comes on, but it only blows warm air. I set it to eighteen degrees and left it for half an hour, and the room actually got warmer.
lines.zh: 能开，但只吹热风。我设到 18 度开了半小时，房间反而更热了。

lines.en: Righto. First things first — you're sure it's on cool and not on dry or fan? The little snowflake on the remote. You'd be surprised how many call-outs that is.
lines.zh: 好的。先确认一下——你确定是制冷模式，不是除湿或送风？遥控器上那个小雪花。这种情况叫我上门的多得你想不到。

lines.en: Yes, I've already checked the mode, and it's definitely on the snowflake. I changed the batteries in the remote too.
lines.zh: 嗯，模式我已经检查过了，确定是雪花。遥控器电池我也换了。

lines.en: Good stuff. And the filters — have you had a squiz at 'em lately? If they're clogged up with dust it'll struggle, but it shouldn't blow hot.
lines.zh: 很好。那滤网呢——最近看过吗？如果积满灰，制冷会吃力，但不至于吹热风。

lines.en: I gave them a rinse on Friday. They weren't too bad.
lines.zh: 我周五冲洗过，不算太脏。

lines.en: Okay, can you duck outside for me and have a look at the outdoor unit while it's running? Is the fan spinnin', and can you hear the compressor humming away?
lines.zh: 好，你能趁它开着的时候出去帮我看一下室外机吗？风扇在转吗？能听到压缩机嗡嗡响吗？

lines.en: Sorry, could you say that again a bit slower? The fan and the… what was the second thing?
lines.zh: 不好意思，能说慢一点再讲一遍吗？风扇，还有……第二个是什么？

lines.en: Sorry, I'm rabbiting on. The compressor — it's the big motor inside the outdoor box. When it's working you'll hear a low hum. Just tell me if the fan's moving and if there's any noise.
lines.zh: 抱歉，我说太快了。压缩机——就是室外机箱子里的大马达。工作的时候你会听到低沉的嗡嗡声。你就告诉我风扇转不转、有没有声音。

lines.en: Okay, I'm outside now. The fan isn't moving at all, and it's pretty quiet. Maybe a little clicking sound.
lines.zh: 好，我在外面了。风扇完全不转，挺安静的，可能有一点咔哒声。

lines.en: Yeah, that clicking's a bit of a giveaway. Could be the capacitor, could be low on gas — I won't know till I get the gauges on it. Either way, it's not a DIY job, so I'd turn it off for now.
lines.zh: 嗯，那个咔哒声挺说明问题的。可能是电容，也可能是缺冷媒——接上压力表才知道。不管哪种都不是自己能修的，先关掉吧。

lines.en: Just to confirm, you mean I shouldn't use it at all until you come?
lines.zh: 我确认一下，你的意思是你来之前我完全不要用它？

lines.en: Spot on. Running it like that won't do the compressor any favours. Now, with this heat comin' we've got a bit of a backlog, so the earliest I can do is Tuesdee arvo. I can give you a window between twelve and three.
lines.zh: 没错。那样开着对压缩机没好处。另外，天要热了我们活儿积了不少，最早周二下午。我可以给你一个 12 点到 3 点的时间段。

lines.en: Tuesday afternoon works. I'll be working from home that day, so someone will be here. Is that something you can fix on the day?
lines.zh: 周二下午可以。那天我在家办公，会有人在。当天能修好吗？

lines.en: If it's the capacitor, yep, I carry those in the van — half an hour, tops. If it needs a regas or a new compressor, I'll quote it up and send it through to your agent for approval, and that can take a few days.
lines.zh: 如果是电容，可以，我车上带着——最多半小时。如果要补冷媒或者换压缩机，我会出报价发给中介审批，那可能要几天。

lines.en: Okay. And who'd be paying for the call-out — me or the landlord?
lines.zh: 好的。那上门费是谁付，我还是房东？

lines.en: It's on the work order, so it goes to the owner. The only time a tenant cops it is if I rock up and it's just dirty filters or someone's left it on fan mode. Sounds like that's not you, so you're right.
lines.zh: 单子是走 work order 的，所以房东付。只有我到了发现只是滤网脏、或者有人开成送风模式，才要租客出。听起来你不是这种情况，所以没问题。

lines.en: That's good to know. Is there anything I need to do before you come? The outdoor unit is down the side of the house, past the gate.
lines.zh: 知道了。你来之前我需要做什么吗？室外机在房子侧面，过了那道门就是。

lines.en: Just make sure the side gate's unlocked and there's a clear path to it — and if you've got a dog, pop it inside. I'll flick you a text the day before and give you a buzz when I'm twenty out.
lines.zh: 把侧门打开、通道清出来就行——如果有狗，先关屋里。我前一天给你发短信，到之前二十分钟打电话。

lines.en: No dog, so that's easy. Could you send me a text with the time window as well, just so I have it in writing? This is the right number — 0491 570 236.
lines.zh: 没养狗，那就简单了。能把时间段也发短信给我吗，有个书面记录？就是这个号码——0491 570 236。

lines.en: Will do. In the meantime, keep the blinds down and maybe grab a pedestal fan from Kmart if it gets nasty Monday. Catch you Tuesdee.
lines.zh: 好的。这期间把百叶窗拉下来，如果周一热得受不了，去 Kmart 买个落地扇。周二见。

lines.en: Thanks so much, Brett. See you Tuesday.
lines.zh: 太谢谢了，Brett。周二见。

rescue.en: Sorry, could you say that again a bit slower?
rescue.zh: 不好意思，能说慢一点再讲一遍吗？

rescue.en: Sorry, what's a ___? I'm not sure what that part is.
rescue.zh: 不好意思，___ 是什么？我不太清楚那个零件。
我确认一下，你的意思是……？

rescue.en: Could you text me the time window, so I have it in writing?
rescue.zh: 能把时间段发短信给我吗？我想有个书面记录。

rescue.en: Could you send the quote to the agent and cc me, please?
rescue.zh: 能把报价发给中介，同时抄送给我吗？

checklist: 我能把故障说清楚：能开机、只吹热风、室外机风扇不转
我能说明自己已经检查过模式、遥控器电池和滤网
我听懂了 have a squiz、duck outside、kick in、clogged up
听到 capacitor、compressor、regas、gauges 这些行话时，我礼貌追问而不是只说 yes
我听懂了 cop the call-out fee 的意思：只有自己的原因才要租客付上门费
我约好了周二 12 点到 3 点的时间段，并请他短信书面确认
